notes: Author-published historical CC 2016 snapshot, source VERSION 2.0. It is not the latest CompCertSSA GitLab revision or modern CompCert.

Original upstream Coq proof target, extraction and compiler build completed with pinned Debian Coq 8.4pl4 / OCaml 4.01.0. The unchanged official i386 Coq kernel executes through fixed native amd64 QEMU, private guest glibc2.33 and official i386 gperftools2.10-1, with a bounded1024MiB ordinary MAP_SHARED file pool. Original amd64 coqc is only a launcher; native amd64 OCaml still builds the compiler. Guest-only allocator settings do not preload the QEMU host or native compiler. Author companion records 8.4pl6 / 4.02.2; both identities are retained. No proof source or kernel was patched, skipped or admitted.

The functional contract is native x86_64 -ssa on/off compilation to ia32 assembly plus real execution of the generated ELF32 programs through the pinned QEMU i386 user-mode emulator, with expected exits 0 and 42 and malformed C rejection. This is a bounded compiler test, not native ia32 hardware evidence, an official benchmark or an unrestricted C correctness claim.

The original ia32 CompCert runtime static library is included. Hosted linking additionally requires a compatible 32-bit C runtime supplied by the consumer platform; the delivered freestanding tests need no 32-bit libc.

GNU gcc/as/ld, Python 3 and compatible Linux x86_64 dynamic libraries are explicit host prerequisites. Native ia32 execution is unavailable on the reference host, so the fixed QEMU i386 executor is bundled. Source replay also uses make, dpkg-deb, Python >=3.12 and libseccomp. No network is used for installation or source replay.

The native package contains the actual compiler, QEMU user-mode executor, capstone4/liburing2 runtime, author source archive/source tree and checked proof objects. All 54 original historical toolchain/runtime/allocator/source inputs and their matching Debian source archives/patches accompany it in raw-inputs/compcert-ssa in the same worker ZIP. Keep that complete delivery together for full offline source replay and the retained component source/license materials. Prefix raw/closure-lock.json is the complete metadata lock; the companion directory contains the complete original archives.

Full source replay takes --inputs /absolute/path/to/unpacked-worker095/raw-inputs/compcert-ssa and restores private source, build and toolchain directories. Only the verified immutable original inputs may be shared read-only. Remaining host dynamic libraries, OS and GNU preprocessing/assembly/linking tools are recorded separately as the platform contract, not represented as a complete OS image.

Proof-runtime restoration uses the exact fixed i386 guest glibc2.33/libstdc++/libgcc/allocator closure under the pinned native amd64 QEMU. The QEMU host requires compatible GLIBC>=2.34 and its listed dynamic libraries; an ordinary writable file system must have space for the bounded1024MiB pool and build outputs, and own-child /proc identity/mappings must be readable in a matching PID view. Its positive proof must exit0, False must be rejected with exit1, and the actual unchanged kernel, selected allocator and rw-s pool mappings must be observed. These small controls do not replace the original CompCert source proof targets. The actual compiler and routine CPG functional checks do not use this allocator.

The historical toolchain execution scope is the command-line Coq proof checker and OCaml build chain. Original Debian Depends fields remain visible; GTK/Emacs distribution integrations are not activated by local archive extraction or used by these proof targets.

The package is independently installed under each prefix; no shared writable build tree or global environment mutation is used. The historical upstream driver expects simple paths without whitespace for its shell preprocessing command.
The whole release includes the original INRIA Non-Commercial License and component GPL/LGPL/BSD terms. Research/evaluation use and redistribution retain the upstream terms and attribution.

Proof source indices, actual proof replay, executable tests, material availability and original global CPG qualification are distinct. The baseline 0.21.14 identities and global statistics are not modified.
